_comment: Each expected fact is a list of keyword groups. A stored fact matches when it contains at least one keyword from every group (case-insensitive). 'keep': [] means nothing in the exchange is worth remembering.

distill.exchange:
Developer: Why SQLite for the cache?

Agent: We chose SQLite over Postgres for the cache because it needs zero setup and the data stays local. The cache layer lives in src/cache.py and is accessed through CacheStore.

Developer: How do we run the tests?

Agent: Run `pytest -q` from the sdk folder. Gotcha: tests must use the fake embedder, otherwise they download a model.

Developer: rename the variable x to count in utils.py

Agent: Done. I renamed x to count in utils.py; it was used in three places.

Developer: No, don't put emojis in commit messages. And always use conventional commits like feat: and fix:.

Agent: Understood. I rewrote the commit message as 'fix: handle empty scope' without emojis.

Developer: Why was login returning 500 in production?

Agent: The root cause was the session cookie being set without the SameSite attribute, so the browser dropped it on the OAuth redirect and the handler crashed on a missing session. I fixed it in auth/middleware.py by setting SameSite=Lax.

Developer: how do I deploy the landing page again?

Agent: From the repo root run `firebase deploy --only hosting`. It publishes the docs folder. Plain `firebase deploy` hangs here, so always pass --only hosting.

Developer: what does the _rank function do?

Agent: It scores each row by cosine similarity against the query vector, sorts them best first and returns the ones above the threshold.

Developer: Remember this for the whole project: all timestamps are stored as UTC ISO-8601 strings. Never write naive datetimes.

Agent: Got it. I changed the new column to use datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat().

Developer: why did two daemons start?

Agent: On Windows, SO_REUSEADDR lets a second process bind a port that is already in use, so both daemons bound 7777. I set allow_reuse_address = False on the server; it must stay False.

Developer: run the tests

Agent: All 43 tests pass in 12 seconds.

Developer: Should local embeddings use sentence-transformers?

Agent: No. We use fastembed, which runs on ONNX, instead of sentence-transformers for local embeddings, because it avoids a 2 GB PyTorch install. sentence-transformers is only kept for the Supabase backend.

Developer: thanks, that looks good

Agent: You're welcome! Let me know if you want anything else changed.

triples.text: The cache uses SQLite instead of Postgres because it needs zero setup.
The CacheStore class is defined in src/cache.py.
The developer prefers conventional commits without emojis.
The landing page is deployed with the command firebase deploy --only hosting.
Local embeddings use fastembed, which depends on ONNX and avoids PyTorch.
The login 500 error was fixed in auth/middleware.py by setting SameSite=Lax on the session cookie.
Tests are run with pytest -q from the sdk folder.
The Dolphin daemon listens on port 7777 on 127.0.0.1.
